scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Hello and welcome!
I am in charge of
explaining the PVP Modes.
I am the PVP Narrator!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
大家好，歡迎光臨！
我負責解說PVP模式。
我是PVP解說員！

scripts.text: What is PVP?
scripts.translation: 什麼是PVP？

scripts.text: What are the PVP Modes?
scripts.translation: PVP有哪些模式？

scripts.text: What are the rules for PVP?
scripts.translation: PVP的規則是什麼？

scripts.text: Save Position.
scripts.translation: 儲存位置

scripts.text: End Dialog.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
In short, PVP means
' Player VS Player Mode '
It's a unique place for people
to duel with each other.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
簡單來說，PVP就是“玩家對戰玩家”的模式。
這裡是供玩家相互決鬥的專用場所。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Just tell the
^3355FFGate Keeper^000000
that you want to try. He will
let you enter the PVP square.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
只要告訴^3355FF守門人^000000你想參加，他就會讓你進入PVP戰鬥廣場。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
But, you need to be at
least level 31. And you
must pay 500 zeny entrance fee in order
to enter a PVP fight square.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
不過，你至少要達到31級，並支付500 Zeny的入場費，才能進入PVP戰鬥廣場。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
When you are qualified, you
can choose one of the two modes.
Yoyo Mode or Nightmare Mode.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
滿足條件後，可以選擇溜溜猴模式或夢魘模式。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Yoyo Mode is risk free.
You can experience PVP
without any restriction or
punishment. It is recommended
that you practice your skills
here before you move on.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
溜溜猴模式沒有風險。
你可以體驗PVP，不受任何限制或懲罰。
建議先在這裡磨練身手，再去挑戰其他模式。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Nightmare Mode is very
dangerous! Please be cautious,
you will lose some of your
EXP when you are defeated. And
there is a small chance that
you will drop some equipment.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
夢魘模式非常危險，請務必小心！
被擊敗時，你會損失一些經驗值，還有小機率掉落裝備。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
However, if you win, the
rewards can be great!
To avoid misunderstanding,
you should think twice
before you go there...
Good Luck!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
不過，獲勝後的獎勵也可能很豐厚！
為了避免誤會，進入之前請三思...
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Each of the fight squares
have a row of Narrators and
choose them based on your
qualifications.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
每個戰鬥廣場都有一排解說員，請根據自己符合的條件選擇。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Each Narrator will ask
which of the five PVP maps
you wish to go to.
Choose, and go in!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
每位解說員都會詢問，你想前往五張PVP地圖中的哪一張。
選好就進去吧！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Each map has a limitation on
the number of people who can
participate. So you will see
figures in the corner showing
'Attendee/Total'.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
每張地圖都有參與人數上限。
所以，你會在角落看到“當前人數/人數上限”的數字。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Also, there is a hidden EXP
value in PVP mode. This EXP
score will only apply inside
of the PVP zone, so do not
worry.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
另外，PVP模式還有一項隱藏的經驗值。
這項經驗值只在PVP區域內有效，不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Every player's EXP at the
beginning is usually 5 points.
If you win, it will
increase by 1 point
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
每位玩家的初始經驗值通常為5點。
獲勝後，會增加1點。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
In the same way, when you
lose... Your EXP will
drop by 5 points.
So be careful!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
同樣，輸了的話...經驗值會減少5點。
所以要小心！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
When you are defeated
And your EXP is equal
to or less than 0,
You will be removed from PVP
and your duel is finished!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
被擊敗時，如果經驗值小於或等於0，就會被送出PVP區域，結束決鬥！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
However, if your EXP is more
than 0. You can still get help
through other players healing...
Do you get it?
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
不過，只要經驗值還大於0，你就能接受其他玩家的治療...
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
The fighting commands inside of
PVP are the same as the normal.
All the basic controls are the
same.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
PVP內的戰鬥指令與普通模式相同。
所有基本操作都是一樣的。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
However, there is one thing...
Within the PVP fight square
and PVP fighting zones,
you cannot save your position.
Remember well... These rules
can help to ensure your victory.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
不過，有一點要注意...
PVP戰鬥廣場和戰鬥區域內不能儲存位置。
記住這些規則，會有助於你獲勝。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Position successfully saved...
Thank you very much!
We will see you again soon.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
位置儲存成功...
非常感謝！
期待再次見到你。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
With war raging between monsters
and humans, this competition
among people - PVP -
encourages us all to get
stronger. Come again,
we welcome your challenge!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解說員]
魔物與人類之間戰火不斷，而人與人之間的PVP較量，也激勵著大家變得更強。
歡迎再來挑戰！

scripts.text:
[Gate Keeper]
Glad to be of service.
I will open the PVP fight
square for you! If you have
any questions about the PVP
modes or rules, Please ask
the Narrator...
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
很高興為你服務。
我會為你開放PVP戰鬥廣場！
關於PVP模式和規則的問題，請諮詢解說員...
